name: embers
description: Keeps your Claude Code context warm: writes a handoff before the prompt cache goes cold, swaps to it when you come back.

ttlMinutes.title: Cache TTL (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: Assumed prompt-cache lifetime; an engine-reported or observed TTL overrides it.

marginMinutes.title: Handoff margin (minutes)
marginMinutes.description: How long before the TTL the handoff is written.

minContextTokens.title: Minimum context (tokens)
minContextTokens.description: Below this context size embers does nothing.

minSavingTokens.title: Minimum saving (tokens)
minSavingTokens.description: A swap must shrink the prefix by at least this many tokens.

coldMode.title: Cold prompt
coldMode.description: On a cold prompt: ask, swap without asking when a handoff matches, send, or off.

offerOnStart.title: Offer handoff on start
offerOnStart.description: Offer the last handoff of this root and branch when a session starts.

handoffInstructions.title: Handoff instructions
handoffInstructions.description: Added to the handoff prompt as its last sentence, such as what to keep or the language to write in. Empty adds nothing.

showBand.title: Show band
showBand.description: Draw the embers band above the prompt.
